analysis.reason: RSI 44.7에서 58.4로 상승하며 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. MACD 히스토그램 0.3946에서 1.4368로 개선되며 상승 추세 강화. 5일 저가 $273.35 대비 현재가 $284.01은 Higher Low 패턴 형성. SMA5 $279.64, SMA20 $277.52 상회하며 단기·중기 이동평균선 지지 확인.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 44.7 to 58.4, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram improved from 0.3946 to 1.4368, strengthening the uptrend. The current price of $284.01 relative to the 5-day low of $273.35 forms a Higher Low pattern. Prices are above SMA5 ($279.64) and SMA20 ($277.52), confirming support from short- and mid-term moving averages.
